state.permissionsDenied: Health Connect permissions were not granted.

ble.askedToPair: {{device}} asked to pair. Accept Android's pairing prompt, then connect again.
ble.cantReach: Couldn’t reach {{device}}. Check Share heart rate is on and nothing else (gym equipment, another app) is connected to it.
ble.refusedStream: {{device}} refused the heart-rate stream. If Android asks to pair, accept it, then connect again.
ble.notSharing: {{device}} isn’t sharing heart rate. Turn on Share heart rate in Google Health.
ble.needsNearby: Pulse needs the Nearby devices permission.
ble.scanPaused: Android paused scanning for a moment (too many scans in a row). Try again in 30 seconds.
ble.needsLocation: Turn on Location: this Android version needs it to scan for Bluetooth devices.
ble.noBandFound: No band found. Check Share heart rate is on in Google Health › Fitbit Air › Connections, and keep the band close.
ble.btUnavailable: Bluetooth isn’t available on this phone.
ble.notSharingConnections: {{device}} isn’t sharing heart rate. Turn on Share heart rate in Google Health › Fitbit Air › Connections.
ble.noBeats: Connected to {{device}}, but no heart rate came. Check Share heart rate is on.
ble.cantFind: Couldn’t find {{device}}. Check Share heart rate is on in Google Health.

sourcePolicy.fitbitOnlyDetail: What your Fitbit device measured, through the Google Health app, plus other apps' workouts at other times and smart scale readings. Phone step counts and other apps' measurements are left out.
sourcePolicy.fitbitFirstDetail: Your Fitbit device's data; on a day it has none of a kind, what your phone or other apps recorded. Other apps' workouts at other times and smart scale readings are kept too.
sourcePolicy.allDetail: Everything in Health Connect. Where apps overlap, Pulse takes the largest source rather than adding them up.
